template: We cannot tell whether Fair Chance in Housing Act – post-offer criminal record limits, lookback periods and withdrawal procedure applies to this address because the rule exempts some small or owner-occupied properties, and we do not have ownership data to check that. Source: P.L. 2021, c.110, §5 (C.46:8-56); as of 2027-07-02. Not legal advice.
rewrite: We can't tell whether the Fair Chance in Housing Act's limits on checking criminal records after a housing offer, including its lookback periods and withdrawal procedure, apply to this address, because the law exempts some small or owner-occupied properties and we don't have the ownership information needed to check. Source: P.L. 2021, c.110, §5 (C.46:8-56); as of 2027-07-02. Not legal advice.
